title: GTA 6 Launch Trailer May Not Utilize Sony's New QSSR Upscaler
description: Sony has introduced QSSR for base PS5 hardware, but media analysis suggests that GTA 6 may not be utilizing this new upscaler in its launch material.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 and Sony's QSSR Upscaler: What We Know So Far

Following Sony's introduction earlier this month of QSSR—bringing a version of the PS5 Pro’s acclaimed PSSR upscaler to base PS5 hardware—the gaming community has been abuzz with speculation regarding how third-party developers will adopt the technology. While the new upscaler is currently incorporated into first-party titles such as Marvel’s Wolverine and Ghost of Yotei, industry discussions have centered on whether massive upcoming releases like Rockstar Games' Grand Theft Auto VI might leverage the tech.

### The Timing and Industry Speculation

Because of the timing surrounding Sony's rollout of QSSR to base hardware, many observers previously speculated that its introduction might have been timed specifically to coincide with the heavily anticipated launch window of GTA 6. Gamers and tech enthusiasts alike have wondered if base PS5 players could see the benefits of this advanced upscaler when experiencing future blockbuster titles.

However, gaming media outlet Push Square recently touched upon the topic, noting that such an implementation for GTA 6's promotional material or launch might be "quite extravagant" and concluding with the sentiment, "I don't think we're seeing it here." As it stands, the technology's integration remains exclusive to select first-party studios, though Sony has confirmed plans to make it available to third-party developers in due course.

### Technical Considerations for Open-World Giants

For a project as massive and complex as GTA 6, rendering pipelines and graphics optimization strategies are typically locked in well ahead of release. While base PS5 hardware improvements like QSSR represent exciting advancements for console longevity, whether major third-party open-world games will immediately adopt or showcase newly released proprietary platform upscalers remains an open question. Fans should continue to monitor official channels for verified technical breakdowns as the game's release approaches.

## Editor's Take

Sony's rollout of QSSR is a welcome boost for base PS5 owners, but expecting massive third-party blockbusters like GTA 6 to immediately showcase the tech might be overly optimistic. Until Rockstar Games or Sony makes an official announcement regarding specific upscaling integrations, discussions surrounding QSSR and GTA 6 remain purely speculative.
